intro: Techno Institute of Management Sciences and University of Lucknow both sit in Lucknow, and this page compares their recorded MCom fees, placements, admission routes and campus setting, using our database and official pages we opened in 2026.

Techno Institute of Management Sciences vs University of Lucknow is not a single winner. Techno Institute of Management Sciences is recorded as a private institute, while University of Lucknow is public. Pick the campus that matches the programme you want, the fee you can pay, and the admission test you will take.

sections.heading: Techno Institute of Management Sciences vs University of Lucknow for MCom: which is better in 2026
paragraphs: Choose University of Lucknow if you want a public MCom option and the admission route and fees that usually come with a government or state university campus.
Choose Techno Institute of Management Sciences if a private campus, its specific specialisation or its recorded placement year fits your plan better, after you have checked the official fee notice.

sections.heading: Fees: what our records show, and what the official pages say
paragraphs: On this page we quote a programme total when we hold a Total Fees record, and we skip application, hostel-only or short-course rows so a registration fee is not treated as tuition.
On this page we record a programme total of ₹91,000 for Techno Institute of Management Sciences's Master of Commerce.
Our records list ₹31,060 a year as total fees for University of Lucknow's Master of Commerce. Treat that as a year figure, not a confirmed full-programme total, until you check the official notice.
If fees are your only filter, confirm the current official circular for the exact programme and batch you will join, because year figures and older rows can understate the real cost.

sections.heading: Placements compared
paragraphs: Our records do not show a 2020 or later flagship placement year for Techno Institute of Management Sciences on this page. Ask the institute for its latest official placement report for the same programme.
Our records do not show a 2020 or later flagship placement year for University of Lucknow on this page. Ask the institute for its latest official placement report for the same programme.
If you are comparing offers, use the latest official placement report from each institute and match the programme name, not an executive or certificate batch.

sections.heading: Admission and eligibility
paragraphs: Our records do not list a specific entrance exam for Techno Institute of Management Sciences on this MCom page. Use the current official admission note for eligibility and tests.
Our records do not list a specific entrance exam for University of Lucknow on this MCom page. Use the current official admission note for eligibility and tests.
Eligibility wording can change by cycle. Use the current official admission brochure rather than last year's cut-off stories.

sections.heading: Location and campus
paragraphs: Both campuses are in Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh. The choice is less about moving city and more about the programme, fees and admission route.
Visit both campuses if you can, or at least read the official hostel and location notes, before you accept an offer.

sections.heading: Verdict: who should pick which college
paragraphs: If you want the stronger recorded public standing or NIRF rank in this pair, University of Lucknow is the safer first pick, after you have checked official fees and seats.
Techno Institute of Management Sciences can still be the better fit if its specialisation, city or recorded fee level matches what you can join this year.
If fees are the only filter, do not use the lowest number in our raw rows. Check each official fee notice for the exact programme and batch you will join.
